entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.
entries.uk: А, точно, сьогодні ж День святого[n]Валентина. То ось чому сюди стільки[n]хлопців із дівчатами приходило.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.
entries.uk: А в тебе що, нічого цікавого[n]не намічається? Ти ж тут уже[n]майже рік.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...
entries.uk: От коли я був молодий, ого-го...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Excuse me...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ah...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Good evening.
Have a seat.[clr 27]
I'll make you some coffee.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Everything was in the cards, you know?
entries.uk: Знаєш, усе це було в картах.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: About you being a prisoner, and you[n]being able to return.
entries.uk: І те, що ти опинишся за ґратами,[n]і те, що зможеш повернутися.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: However, I'm shocked about this, even[n]though I knew about it...
entries.uk: Та все одно я приголомшена, хоч і знала[n]про це наперед...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Do you know what today is?
Valentine's?[clr 27]
I don't know.
Some sort of holiday?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's right!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You could at least check your calendar.
entries.uk: Міг би хоч у календар зазирнути.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You almost guessed right.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Here...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It has your lucky color and number.
entries.uk: Тут твій щасливий колір і число.

entries.en: Thanks.[clr 27]
I wonder how they taste.
What's inside?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm glad that you're happy.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I think it's good as is.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Chocolate, of course.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I had to wait in a really long line to buy it,[n]and a girl stomped on my foot on her[n]way out...
entries.uk: Довелося вистояти довжелезну чергу,[n]а одна дівчина на виході ще й[n]наступила мені на ногу...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But it kind of made me... happy.
entries.uk: Але мені від цього було якось...[n]радісно.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm still telling fortunes, but I've cut all[n]ties with the chairman.
entries.uk: Я й досі ворожу, але розірвала всі[n]зв'язки з головою.

entries.en: That's a relief.
Wasn't that tough?
I've missed you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Because... fate can be changed, right?
entries.uk: Бо ж... долю можна змінити, правда?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's... something you should be able to[n]perceive on your own.
entries.uk: Це... те, що ти мав би відчути[n]й сам.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I was thinking the same thing...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've been getting thanked a lot more[n]lately. Even by the people who receive[n]bad fortunes!
entries.uk: Останнім часом мені дякують значно[n]частіше. Навіть ті, кому випадає[n]лихе пророцтво!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Sometimes I feel like all my time is[n]consumed with counseling other[n]people about their relationships.
entries.uk: Часом здається, що весь мій час іде[n]на поради іншим людям щодо їхніх[n]стосунків.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But a fortune teller is allowed to be[n]happy too, right?
entries.uk: Але ж ворожка теж має право[n]бути щасливою, правда?

entries.en: I should tell Chihaya that[n]I'm going home...
entries.uk: Треба сказати Тіхаї, що[n]я їду додому...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um...
I'll be returning to my hometown.
I'm going home.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'd like to sit next to you...
entries.uk: Я хотіла б сісти біля тебе...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There's just one thing that I haven't[n]been able to see yet.
entries.uk: Є лише одне, чого я досі[n]не змогла побачити.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And I'm a little scared to know[n]the answer...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're going home next month, correct?
entries.uk: Ти ж наступного місяця їдеш додому, так?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Is there anything I can do for you...?
entries.uk: Я можу щось для тебе зробити?..

entries.en: Wait for me.
Want to tag along?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Okay, I will.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You mean...!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I-I have my job... a-and we're both[n]still...
entries.uk: Але в м-мене робота... і-і ми обоє[n]ще...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I... didn't anticipate this...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...We have to think this through.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm here with you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You wanna know what I'm thinking?
entries.uk: Хочеш знати, про що я думаю?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's that I wish this moment would[n]last forever...
entries.uk: Про те, що хотіла б, аби ця мить[n]тривала вічно...

entries.en: I spent a romantic evening[n]with Chihaya...
